ecessary shall be borne by the Contractor. 11. Conservancy cess charges as applicable will be recovered from contractor's bills. 12. The contractors should indemnify the Railway for any amount the contractor has to pay towards da mages/compensation arising out of the contract. 26. The mobile SIM should be from a mobile service of that of CUG s ervice provider to Railways to ensure signal availability in railway premises. 27. In case of any variation in the prices of fuel either on increasing / decreasing side will not be taken i nto consideration and only the accepted rate as per the contract will confirm to be applicable in the entire period of contract. 28. Any illegal article/material transported at any time in the vehicle will result in termination of contra ct and the Performance Guarantee available will stand forfeited. No correspondence in this matter w ill be entertained. 29. A verification report in respect of all the personnel of Service Provider from t he concerned police station of concerned residential areas should be submitted after the awarded of

contract. 30. Availability of current vehicle fitness certificate obtained from RTO should be made available for ve rification at any time. 31. All taxes, insurance, certificates (pollution control etc) statutory provision, FasTag Toll charges etc a s per local/state laws are to be followed including timely renewals shall be complied by the contract or and no separate payment will be made for this. 32. The vehicle shall be available at nominated time and place on all days as per the directions of SSE/ DSL/GOC or authorized representative of Sr.DME/DSL/GOC from time to time. 33. Vehicle should be registered in the name of bidder and should not sublet any part of the contract. H owever, the bidder can have Lease Agreement with the owner of the vehicle/cab aggregator on non- judicial stamp paper, which should be submitted along with the bid. 34. The bidder is required to submit the Vehicle registration details along with supporting documents of the vehicle fulfilling the category, specifications etc. 35. It is mandatory for the bidder to submit documents in fulfillment of conditions, failing to submit the same along with the bid, the offer will be summarily rejected. 36. The bidders are required to read the bid completely along with all attached documents before parti cipation. 37. It is the sole responsibility of bidders to access requirement of service to be provided under this bid before the submission of their offer. In case of bidder withdraws their offer, action of suspension of b idder in GeM account shall be initiated. 38. The contractor should register & up load all the details like LOA, Labour, Paymen t, ESI & EPF etc.., in the Railway’s Sharmik kalyan portal @ www.sharmikkalyan.i ndianrailways@gov.in and in "Shram suvidha portal 2.0" as per new labour c odes The following documents to be submitted along with the bid (at a glance): a) Geographical Location of the Service Provider at the consignee's location, Tiruchchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, and should have an office in Tiruchchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. (to be uploaded in the bid document named as 'Registration Certificate for Geographical Presence as required by the Buyer' onl y). b) MSE/NSIC/Startup Certificate (If applicable - to be uploaded in the bid document named as 'MSE Categ ory Certificate' only). c) Proof of Registration of vehicle in State of Tamil Nadu and ownership of one vehicle or le ase agreement with owner of vehicles for one vehicle. The vehicle make/models should b e the same as per the vehicle selection make/models made in the GeM bid document. (To be uploaded in the bid document requested in ATC only). The bidders not satisfying the above conditions will be rejected. .
